summary: Nuran Wireless Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K with the SEC for September 2026, including its condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results and contains no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. No event triggering a special-situations category is identified; the filing is standard disclosure under Rule 13a-16 and not a corporate action warranting classification.
